name: Six Seven
summary:
Enter the world of Six Seven, where music and combat become one.

Face waves of incoming enemies and defeat them with perfectly timed attacks synchronized to the beat. Every strike, dodge, and combo depends on your rhythm, precision, and reflexes.

Build score multipliers, maintain long combo chains, and push your skills to the limit as the music intensifies. The better your timing, the higher your score.

Features:

• Rhythm-based combat gameplay
• Slash enemies to the beat
• Combo and score multiplier sys
